gaps: 2022-09-08 (王强): the Xinhua politics/leaders page is a photo item whose caption names 北部战区司令员王强; the full dispatch text (上午11时许, 许其亮宣读, 张又侠主持) was only seen in a search snippet of the Xinhua Daily Telegraph reprint. news.cn/mrdx/2022-09/09/c_1310660867.htm now redirects to mrdx.cn; paper.people.com.cn 2022-09-09 returned 403; stcn.com reprint failed via proxy (502).

2021-09-06: the Xinhua URL found (c_1127833663) is the photo page; the five names were confirmed from the People's Daily reprint of the same 新华社 dispatch (politics.people.com.cn/n1/2021/0907/c1024-32219362.html). A text-version Xinhua URL was not located before the WebSearch budget ran out.

Billet-newness judgments rely on zh.wikipedia career chronologies (secondary) plus same-day/next-day commentary (新京报 2021-09-06, 南方都市报 2022-01-22, 政知见 2023-06-29 and 2023-12-26, 财新 2026-07-03). No official '由...调任' language exists in the Xinhua ceremony reports themselves. Officers flagged as most uncertain: 王春宁 (Wikipedia gives no explicit PAP commander appointment month), 许学强 (Wikipedia disambiguation page; relies on 新京报 statement that all five billets were first disclosed), 何宏军 (常务副主任 designation new, but deputy director since 2019), 王刚 (Wikipedia says 空军司令员 from 2025-12 but page is marked thinly sourced).

No ceremony found for calendar 2025 before 2025-12-22, and none in 2026 other than 2026-07-03 through the 2026-09-02 cutoff. The china-cdt.com item filed under '2025/4' is a reprint of the 2023-12-25 report (王文全/胡中明); the site returned 504 so this rests on the search snippet.

No ceremonies found in 2022 other than 2022-01-21 and 2022-09-08, in 2020 other than 2020-07-29 and 2020-12-18, and in 2021 other than 2021-07-05 and 2021-09-06; 2023 had four (Jan 18, Jun 28, Jul 31, Dec 25) per 政知见's own count, and 2024 three (Mar 28, Jul 9, Dec 23). Exhaustiveness beyond these rests on year-by-year searches; the session's WebSearch quota (200) was exhausted at the end, so no further sweep was possible.
